# Catalyst Calendar Skill for Muse

A five-step workflow to build and maintain a stock-catalyst calendar over your watch universe: define the universe (tickers, sectors, horizon), collect events — earnings, corporate (FDA, M&A, launches), sector conferences, macro (FOMC, CPI, jobs). You get a calendar view with impact (H/M/L) and positioning (Long/Short/Neutral) columns, a weekly recap with consensus versus your own estimates, and a sortable Excel workbook plus a markdown note (optional Google Calendar integration). Practitioner notes included: earnings dates move and must be verified on IR pages, track pre-announce history, color-code by impact, archive past catalysts for pattern recognition. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: an investor/trader niche; dates need manual verification (they move); Excel/markdown output — no live data-feed integration. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
